meta.name: X-to-Demo Task Group B — Prompt Overhaul (AI-first + Anti-drift)

role.objective: Update the X-to-Demo pipeline prompting so each phase reliably produces AI-first, minimalist, schema-compliant artifacts (1–3 headline items) without scope/plumbing drift, while keeping the pipeline at exactly 3 phases.

context.tool_description: X-to-Demo generates three artifacts via a 3-phase pipeline: feature_spec → demo_spec → code_spec. Each phase is a single structured-output call to OpenAI with strict JSON Schema. The “demo” is the downstream app being specified/built, not the X-to-Demo studio UI.

core_principles.principle: AI/technical innovation is first-class and must be central in all phases.
Constrain demonstrable scope to 1–3 headline items; everything else is out of scope.
Avoid plumbing by default (auth, billing, observability, etc.) unless explicitly required.
Minimalist UI; system dark/light theme always.
Smartphone-framed browser view only if the proposal indicates a mobile app.
Walkthrough is an interactive in-app UI tour (auto-start, retriggerable, cancellable); not a presenter script.
Tools only if absolutely necessary; if used: synthetic data + UI-visible tool call/result log.
At least one OpenAI integration choice must appear in phase 3 (Responses, Realtime, and/or Agents SDK).
Output must match JSON Schema exactly; no extra fields; no invented requirements.

in_scope.item: Task Group B only: update pipeline prompts to enforce the principles above.
Single target file: apps/api/app/x_to_demo/pipeline/prompts.py (unless tests require minimal additions).

out_of_scope.item: Do not add new pipeline phases (no Phase 0 gates).
Do not modify schema files in this task group.
Do not touch apps/web/** or XToDemoStudio UX/auth concerns.
Do not add “plumbing” requirements into prompts.

file.purpose: Build developer/system and user prompts for each pipeline phase.

task.title: Overhaul developer prompt to encode principles as hard rules (phase-aware)

requirements.requirement: Replace generic developer prompt(s) with phase-aware rules that: enforce AI-first framing, 1–3 headline items, minimalist UI, no-plumbing default, theme support, conditional smartphone frame, walkthrough requirements, and tools policy.
Ensure Phase 3 rule explicitly requires selecting ≥1 OpenAI API (responses|realtime|agents) and justifying choice.
Ensure rules explicitly state: no presenter script; walkthrough is in-app UI tour.

task.title: Improve user prompt payload framing to prioritize new schema fields

requirements.requirement: Add a concise phase-specific “priority checklist” to the user prompt (or the composed prompt payload) in addition to: schema excerpt and the input proposal/payload.

Checklist content must be:
Identify 1–3 headline AI capabilities; define guardrails summary; assess tooling need (tools only if necessary).
Map headline capabilities into minimalist views; specify interactive walkthrough (auto-start + retrigger); delineate AI vs non-AI components; confirm theme + device framing.
Choose OpenAI API(s) + initial prompts; define schemas/structured outputs; specify guardrails; specify walkthrough implementation approach; mandate unit tests and mocking strategy.

task.title: Add lightweight anti-drift reminders tied to strict JSON output

requirements.requirement: Anti-drift language must be short, unambiguous, and repeatable across phases.

implementation_guidance.step: Open apps/api/app/x_to_demo/pipeline/prompts.py and identify how prompts are constructed per phase.
Implement a phase-aware developer prompt builder. Prefer: shared “global hard rules” + small phase-specific additions, to avoid duplication and ensure consistent enforcement.
Implement a phase-aware user prompt builder that includes: schema excerpt (as currently done), the user input proposal/payload, and the short phase checklist.

Ensure the composed prompt content is compatible with structured outputs: it should emphasize “JSON only” and schema-only fields, without adding any formatting requirements that conflict with the caller.

Run existing unit tests. If there are prompt-related tests, update them. If no tests exist, add the smallest reasonable tests (only if the repo already has a testing harness) to assert that each phase prompt contains the required hard-rule phrases/checklist markers.

must_not_break.item: Prompt builder function signatures used by the pipeline (keep interfaces stable unless strictly necessary).
Any schema-attachment or schema-excerpt mechanism currently relied on.
Strict JSON structured-output expectations (no encouraging markdown, no extra wrapping).

definition_of_done.item: B1: Developer prompt includes global hard rules + phase-specific rules; Phase 3 enforces OpenAI API selection.
B2: User prompt payload includes an explicit phase checklist (feature_spec/demo_spec/code_spec).
B3: Anti-drift reminders exist and clearly prohibit adding fields/plumbing and require schema-exact JSON.
All existing unit tests pass; any new tests added are minimal and stable.

non_goals.item: Do not modify schemas in this task group.
Do not add new fields or acceptance criteria beyond what schemas already require.
Do not introduce external tools or dependencies for prompt building.

final_response_instructions.deliverable: Provide a concise implementation summary and a diff/patch (or file-level changes) for prompts.py (and any minimal test changes, if created).

reporting.item: List the exact hard-rule statements included (or where to find them in code).
Show how phase-awareness is determined (phase enum/name mapping).
State which tests were run and their result.
